SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'RecordCount' FROM
(SELECT a.[TradeID],
 a.[BookID],
 a.[ProductType],
 a.[ContractState],
 a.[PrivateProcessState],
 a.[CounterPartyBIC],
 a.[DealDate],
 a.[LoadDate]
  FROM [tbl_DE_CLRbaseline] a 
  LEFT JOIN tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal b ON a.tradeId = b.TradeID
  WHERE b.TradeID is null
	AND a.productType <> 'Index Variance Swap' 
	AND a.productType <> 'Equity Index Option' 
	And a.productType <> 'Offline Trade Credit Summary' 
	And a.productType <> 'Offline Trade Credit' 
	And a.productType <> 'Equity Share Option'
	AND (a.privateProcessState = 'Pending' OR a.privateProcessState = 'Done')
	AND a.counterpartyBic <> 'PNBPUS33CHA' 
	And a.counterpartyBic <> 'WFBNASF') AS c

INSERT INTO [tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal]
           ([TradeID]
           ,[BookID]
           ,[ProductType]
           ,[ContractState]
           ,[PrivateProcessState]
           ,[CounterPartyBIC]
           ,[VersionTimestamp]
           ,[LoadDate])
 (SELECT a.[TradeID],
 a.[BookID],
 a.[ProductType],
 a.[ContractState],
 a.[PrivateProcessState],
 a.[CounterPartyBIC],
 a.[DealDate],
 a.[LoadDate]
  FROM [tbl_DE_CLRbaseline] a 
  LEFT JOIN tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal b ON a.tradeId = b.TradeID
  WHERE b.TradeID is null
	AND a.productType <> 'Index Variance Swap' 
	AND a.productType <> 'Equity Index Option' 
	And a.productType <> 'Offline Trade Credit Summary' 
	And a.productType <> 'Equity Index Option Strategy' 
	And a.productType <> 'Offline Trade Credit' 
	And a.productType <> 'Equity Share Option'
	AND (a.privateProcessState = 'Pending' OR a.privateProcessState = 'Done')
	AND a.counterpartyBic <> 'PNBPUS33CHA' 
	And a.counterpartyBic <> 'WFBNASF')

INSERT INTO tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingStatusDrop
(TradeID, PrivateProcessState)
(SELECT tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal.TradeID, tbl_DE_CLRbaseline.privateProcessState
FROM tbl_DE_CLRbaseline RIGHT JOIN tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal ON tbl_DE_CLRbaseline.tradeId = tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal.TradeID
WHERE tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal.TradeID=tbl_DE_CLRbaseline.tradeId AND tbl_DE_CLRbaseline.privateProcessState<>'Pending' And tbl_DE_CLRbaseline.privateProcessState<>'Done' AND tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal.PrivateProcessState<>tbl_DE_CLRbaseline.privateProcessState)

UPDATE tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal 
SET tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal.PrivateProcessState = tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingStatusDrop.PrivateProcessState
FROM tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal INNER JOIN tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingStatusDrop ON tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal.TradeID = tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingStatusDrop.tradeId
WHERE tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal.PrivateProcessState<>tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingStatusDrop.PrivateProcessState AND tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal.tradeId=tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingStatusDrop.TradeId

update [dbo].[tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal]
set CalDaysInStatus = DATEDIFF(DAY,left(VersionTimestamp,10),getdate()),
WorkdaysInStatus = dbo.fn_BusinessDayCount(left(VersionTimestamp,10),getdate()) -1
from [dbo].[tbl_REODR_DoneOrPendingNotInternal]
where [PrivateProcessState] in('Pending','Done') and (Unresolvable is null or Unresolvable = 0)
